title: Quandale Dingle
blurb: Quandale Dingle — a name screenshotted from a school PC login that spiralled into one of the most committed absurdist sagas the internet has produced. Fans invented an entire universe around a stranger's lock screen: impossible family lore, escalating crimes, deep-fried voices, hundreds of micro-narratives each dumber than the last. The comedy is entirely in the commitment; nobody involved ever broke character. Play it as a greeting, a non-sequitur, or a tribute to the era when a random name became genuine internet folklore.
origin: From a screenshot of a PC login for 'Quandale Dingle', which became a deep-fried meme universe.
